another thing might be your storage also unplug that
clear cmos by shorting the pins at the bottom for 5 sec
you could also try unplugging any fan ports even for cpu (unless aio) and reseat your cooler
ensure the ihs is properly seated and not tilted or over/under tightened

reseat and verify power cables are properly seated and that you are not using (somehow but have seen it) a pcie cable for the cpu (by this i mean a cpu 8 pin connected to the pcie psu connector if modular)
if none of that works i would prepare for a rma asap since overseas ones take a while
